content: Google Apps Script Web Apps do not implement OPTIONS/preflight handling -- a JSON POST (application/json) triggers a browser preflight that Apps Script cannot answer, causing the request to fail. Workaround: send Content-Type: text/plain;charset=utf-8 so the browser classifies it as a CORS simple request (no preflight). The exec endpoint responds with a 302 redirect to script.googleusercontent.com/macros/echo?... which serves the actual output; fetch follows this redirect transparently by default (redirect: 'follow') and the final response is readable by JS as long as the original request had no custom/non-simple headers.
